messages.subject: Call for GSOC2017 project proposals
parts:
Dear GSOC mentors, as you may know, the admin applications for GSOC2017 begin next week. Brian Peterson and I will take care of it again, as in previous years.

The amount of project ideas is one of the criteria that the Google folks use to evaluate open-source organizations such as the R project. I have set up a project ideas page on https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/wiki/table-of-proposed-coding-projects and I have already posted a few ideas. If you can post your own ideas in the next two weeks (by Feb 10), we would be grateful, as it would strengthen our admin application.

Thanks in advance, and looking forward to working with you all in another GSOC.

Toby
